prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first design-review concept for a 1x1 tile EVA engineering exosuit in RimWorld mod RimExodus Delta-V, transparent game sprite.
Primary request: A compact single-person space construction exosuit inspired directly by the industrial silhouette of the StarCraft Terran SCV: central enclosed pilot canopy, very broad shoulder machinery, unequal practical engineering arms, compact rear maneuvering backpack. Adapt to RimWorld's clear hand-drawn sprite language and a one-tile footprint.
Composition: ONE isolated complete unit centered on a square transparent canvas, facing UP/NORTH. Strict orthographic overhead view, camera directly above, no perspective or isometric tilt. See top of canopy and shoulders. Folded lower-body/boots tucked close to the rear, floating EVA stance. The unit occupies roughly 78 percent of canvas width and height with clean transparent margins. All limbs and tools inside the footprint.
Design: squat rounded hexagonal central gray-white pressure body, a single small dark teal glazed canopy inset toward front, mustard yellow broad shoulder/backpack plates, dark gray joints. One short arm ends in a chunky two-prong cargo manipulator, other short arm ends in a blunt twin-aperture cutter/welder head with tiny amber tip. No long drill: this game uses cutting and welding beams. Arms reach slightly forward beside canopy. Rear compact rectangular life support/cargo pack with clear small maneuvering nozzles at outer edges. Strong human-operated industrial work-machine reading. A handful of large armor panels only.
Style: thick clean near-black outer outline; simple flat neutral gray, cream and muted engineering yellow shapes, two or three hard-edged shades per material, narrow edge highlights; a tiny blue-green glass accent. Simplify aggressively for 48 pixels per tile. Match the project's existing gray armor and yellow engineering devices. Keep silhouette asymmetrical through tool shapes. No micro bolts, greebles, fine vents, scratches, text, logos, decals, labels, floor, scenery, shadow, exhaust, beam effects, UI, diagram or multiple views. This is a game-art concept, not a photorealistic 3D render. Background genuinely transparent.
review: SCV-inspired canopy, shoulder pack and asymmetric tools are legible. Output is too frontal for production; orthographic viewpoint, four-direction consistency and game-scale review remain pending.
